description:
There’s so much to see, do, and snap in Bluey’s Happy Snaps! 📷
Join Bindi Irwin to zoom in on the exciting details in this brand-new Bluey adventure. Explore real locations from the show, play heaps of games, and snap wonderful wildlife around Bluey’s home! 🦘
Ready to play for real life? Bluey’s Happy Snaps releases on XBOX October 15th.

description:
Don't! Fret is a stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. 

This trailer reveals that Don't Fret is coming to XBOX Series X|S this Winter! 

Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights. Watch the Don't! Fret trailer to see puzzles, gameplay, and its nightmarish world.
